MA-LIS-F00-Q01.text: Let's start gently. Listen to the question, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-F00-Q02.text: What number answers the question? Listen, then tap it.

MA-LIS-F00-Q03.text: Here's a quick question to listen to. Work it out, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-F00-Q04.text: A tiny story with numbers is coming. Tap the answer when it ends.

MA-LIS-F00-Q05.text: Tap the number you hear. Take your time.

MA-LIS-F00-Q06.text: Take your time. Listen to the question, then choose your answer.

MA-LIS-F00-Q07.text: You'll hear two numbers. Listen to the question, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-F00-Q08.text: Short question coming. Tap the answer you think is right.

MA-LIS-S06-Q01.text: This one involves numbers below zero. Listen carefully, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-S06-Q02.text: Picture a number line that goes below zero as you listen. Then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-S06-Q03.text: Work this one out in your head after you hear it. Then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-S06-Q04.text: Every word of this question matters. Listen closely, work it out, and tap your answer.

MA-LIS-S07-Q01.text: Here's a missing-number puzzle. Listen carefully, then tap what number it must be.

MA-LIS-S07-Q02.text: This one takes careful thinking. Listen to the whole question, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-S08-Q01.text: Listen to the question and take a moment to work it out. Then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-S08-Q02.text: Think it through carefully once you've heard the question. Then tap the number you believe is right.

MA-LIS-T01-Q01.text: When the number plays, listen closely, then tap the one that matches.

MA-LIS-T01-Q02.text: A number is coming up. Listen closely, then find it on the screen and tap it.

MA-LIS-T01-Q03.text: Ready? You'll hear one number. Tap the matching number on the screen.

MA-LIS-T01-Q04.text: Tune in to the number, then pick it out from the choices and tap it.

MA-LIS-T01-Q05.text: Spot the number: listen for it, then find it among the choices and tap it.

MA-LIS-T01-Q06.text: One number, one tap. Listen, then tap the number you heard.

MA-LIS-T01-Q07.text: Let the whole number finish, then tap the one that matches.

MA-LIS-T01-Q08.text: Here comes a number. Listen, then choose the matching one on the screen.

MA-LIS-T01-Q09.text: Some of the choices look a bit alike, so listen closely. Then tap the number you hear.

MA-LIS-T01-Q10.text: Some of these numbers use the same digits, so listen carefully. Then tap the one you heard.

MA-LIS-T02-Q01.text: Get counting. Listen to the number, then tap the picture that shows that many.

MA-LIS-T02-Q02.text: You'll hear a number. Count the things in each picture and tap the picture that matches.

MA-LIS-T02-Q03.text: Count carefully after you listen. Tap the picture with exactly that many.

MA-LIS-T02-Q04.text: How many? Listen for the number, then tap the picture that has that many.

MA-LIS-T02-Q05.text: The pictures look close, so count each one. Listen to the number first, then tap the picture that matches.

MA-LIS-T02-Q06.text: Here comes a number. Find the picture with that many and tap it. Counting with your finger can help.

MA-LIS-T02-Q07.text: Puzzle pieces to count. Listen carefully, then tap the picture that matches the number.

MA-LIS-T02-Q08.text: Coins to count. Listen for the number, then tap the picture with that many.

MA-LIS-T02-Q09.text: Lots to count here. Listen to the number, then tap the picture that shows exactly that many.

MA-LIS-T02-Q10.text: Big counting job. Listen to the number, then take your time counting each picture before you tap one.

MA-LIS-T03-Q01.text: Look at the picture, then listen to the sentence. Is it true? Tap the tick or the cross.

MA-LIS-T03-Q02.text: What's said about the picture? Listen, count carefully, then tap the tick if it's true, or the cross if it isn't.

MA-LIS-T03-Q03.text: Here's a picture to check. Listen to the sentence, look again, and tap the tick or the cross.

MA-LIS-T03-Q04.text: Count the picture first. Then listen. Does the sentence match? Tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T03-Q05.text: Here's a little number story. Is it true? Listen, then tap the tick or the cross.

MA-LIS-T03-Q06.text: Think this sentence through after you hear it. Is it true? Tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T03-Q07.text: Shape fact check. Listen, then tap the tick if it's right, or the cross if it isn't.

MA-LIS-T03-Q08.text: Picture the shape in your head as you listen. Is the sentence true? Tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T03-Q09.text: Look at the picture, then listen to the whole sentence. Does it match what you see? Tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T03-Q10.text: Check the picture carefully, then listen right to the end of the sentence. Is it true? Tap the tick or the cross.

MA-LIS-T04-Q01.text: Pay close attention. Tap the number you hear.

MA-LIS-T04-Q02.text: Listen first, then look. Which number did you hear? Tap it.

MA-LIS-T04-Q03.text: A single number is coming. Listen, and tap the one that matches.

MA-LIS-T04-Q04.text: Careful: some of these choices use the same digits. Listen closely, then tap the number you hear.

MA-LIS-T04-Q05.text: Some numbers sound alike, so listen right to the end. Then tap the number you heard.

MA-LIS-T04-Q06.text: The choices look alike, so listen carefully and check each one before you tap.

MA-LIS-T04-Q07.text: Tune in closely. Then tap the number that matches what you heard, not just one that looks close.

MA-LIS-T04-Q08.text: Some numbers sound a lot alike, so listen to every part. Then tap the number you heard.

MA-LIS-T04-Q09.text: Ready? Listen to the number, then find it on the screen. Watch out, some choices look like twins.

MA-LIS-T04-Q10.text: Here comes a tricky one. Listen all the way to the end of the number, then tap it.

MA-LIS-T05-Q01.text: Shape name coming up. Listen, then tap the picture that matches it.

MA-LIS-T05-Q02.text: You'll hear a shape. Find it in the pictures and tap it.

MA-LIS-T05-Q03.text: Shape hunt. Listen, then tap the picture of the shape you heard.

MA-LIS-T05-Q04.text: Which picture is the shape you hear? Listen carefully, then tap it.

MA-LIS-T05-Q05.text: Here comes a shape word. Tap the picture that shows that shape.

MA-LIS-T05-Q06.text: Look at each picture after you listen. Tap the picture of the shape you heard.

MA-LIS-T05-Q07.text: Can you find the shape? Listen to its name, then tap the matching picture.

MA-LIS-T05-Q08.text: Ears on. Listen for a shape, then tap the picture that matches.

MA-LIS-T05-Q09.text: Counting the sides in each picture can help here. Listen to the shape's name, then tap your choice.

MA-LIS-T05-Q10.text: Sides and corners are good clues. Listen for the shape's name, then tap the picture you think matches.

MA-LIS-T06-Q01.text: This question is about which number sits next to another. Listen, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T06-Q02.text: You'll be asked about a number's neighbour. Listen carefully, then tap the answer.

MA-LIS-T06-Q03.text: Think of a number line in your head. Listen to the question, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T06-Q04.text: Listen closely: is the question asking before or after? Then tap the number that fits.

MA-LIS-T06-Q05.text: Count on or back in your head. Listen to the question first, then tap the number you land on.

MA-LIS-T06-Q06.text: Before or after? Listen for that word, then tap the number that answers the question.

MA-LIS-T06-Q07.text: Picture the counting numbers in a row. Listen to the question and tap the number that answers it.

MA-LIS-T06-Q08.text: Work out the number's neighbour. Listen carefully, then tap it.

MA-LIS-T06-Q09.text: Number neighbours time. Listen to the question, then tap the number that lives right next door.

MA-LIS-T06-Q10.text: Hop along the number line in your head. Listen, then tap the number that answers the question.

MA-LIS-T07-Q01.text: Two numbers are coming, and you'll be told whether you need the bigger or the smaller. Tap that one.

MA-LIS-T07-Q02.text: Bigger or smaller? Listen carefully to which one you're asked for, then tap it.

MA-LIS-T07-Q03.text: You'll hear two numbers to compare. Listen, then tap the one the question asks for.

MA-LIS-T07-Q04.text: What are you looking for? The end of the question tells you. Listen, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T07-Q05.text: Compare the two numbers you hear in your head, then tap the one the question wants.

MA-LIS-T07-Q06.text: Careful, these two numbers use the same digits. Listen, compare, and tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T07-Q07.text: Money question coming. Compare the two amounts you hear, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T07-Q08.text: The two choices look alike, so think about tens and ones. Listen carefully, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T07-Q09.text: This one needs a little working out. Listen, work out each amount, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T07-Q10.text: Work out both amounts in your head after you listen. Then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T08-Q01.text: A number pattern is coming. What comes next? Tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T08-Q02.text: You'll hear some numbers in a pattern. Work out the rule, then tap the number that comes next.

MA-LIS-T08-Q03.text: How do the numbers change each time? Listen for that, then tap what comes next.

MA-LIS-T08-Q04.text: Here's a pattern to crack. Listen, find the rule, and tap the next number.

MA-LIS-T08-Q05.text: Up or down, and by how much? Listen to the numbers, then tap what comes next.

MA-LIS-T08-Q06.text: Pattern detectives listen for the jump between numbers. Listen, then tap what comes next.

MA-LIS-T08-Q07.text: Keep the rule in mind as you listen to the pattern. Then tap the number that follows.

MA-LIS-T08-Q08.text: Hear the whole pattern before you decide. What comes next? Tap it.

MA-LIS-T08-Q09.text: Here's a tricky pattern. Listen to all the numbers, think about how they're linked, then tap what comes next.

MA-LIS-T08-Q10.text: Listen to the numbers marching along. What comes next in the pattern? Tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T09-Q01.text: Which number comes next in the count? Listen, then tap it.

MA-LIS-T09-Q02.text: Someone is skip counting. Listen, then tap the number they would say next.

MA-LIS-T09-Q03.text: Notice the size of each jump in the count, then tap what comes next.

MA-LIS-T09-Q04.text: Keep the count going in your head. Listen, then tap the next number.

MA-LIS-T09-Q05.text: Work out the step in this counting pattern, then tap what comes next.

MA-LIS-T09-Q06.text: Which way is the count going? Listen carefully, then tap the next number.

MA-LIS-T09-Q07.text: A counting story is coming. Tap the number that comes next in the count.

MA-LIS-T09-Q08.text: This count takes bigger jumps. Listen, then tap the number that comes next.

MA-LIS-T09-Q09.text: Jump along with the count. Listen, then tap where the next jump lands.

MA-LIS-T09-Q10.text: Hop, hop, hop. Listen to the count, then tap the number that comes after.

MA-LIS-T10-Q01.text: A short story with numbers is coming. Tap the answer to the question at the end.

MA-LIS-T10-Q02.text: Here's a little story. Listen for the numbers and what happens to them, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T10-Q03.text: Picture the story as you hear it. Then tap the number that answers the question.

MA-LIS-T10-Q04.text: Is something being added or taken away in this story? Listen, work it out, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T10-Q05.text: Hold the numbers in your head as the story plays. Then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T10-Q06.text: A short word problem is coming. Listen, think about what's happening, and tap the answer.

MA-LIS-T10-Q07.text: Stay with the story all the way through, then tap the number that answers the question.

MA-LIS-T10-Q08.text: Keep track of the numbers as you listen. Then choose your answer.

MA-LIS-T10-Q09.text: Story time with numbers. Listen carefully, then tap the answer to the question.

MA-LIS-T10-Q10.text: Get comfy and listen to this story. When the question comes, work it out and tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T11-Q01.text: This one has two steps. Listen, keep track of each change, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T11-Q02.text: Two steps are coming. Listen to each part in order, then tap the final answer.

MA-LIS-T11-Q03.text: Something happens, then something else happens. Listen carefully, work through both steps, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T11-Q04.text: Two-step challenge. Listen to the whole story before you start working it out, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T11-Q05.text: One step at a time: there are two steps before you reach the answer. Listen closely, then tap it.

MA-LIS-T11-Q06.text: Keep a running total in your head as you listen. There are two steps. Then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T11-Q07.text: Each change comes one after the other. When you've done both steps, tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T11-Q08.text: This story has two steps. Listen carefully to every number, then tap what you get at the end.

MA-LIS-T11-Q09.text: A two-step puzzle is on its way. Listen to every number, work through it one step at a time, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T11-Q10.text: Ready for a two-step puzzle? Listen closely, solve the first step, then the second, and tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T12-Q01.text: Coins are involved here. Listen, then tap the amount you think is right.

MA-LIS-T12-Q02.text: Here's a question about time. Listen, picture the clock, and tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T12-Q03.text: Listen carefully to this coin question, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T12-Q04.text: Think about a clock as you listen. Then tap the answer to the question.

MA-LIS-T12-Q05.text: Work out this money question once you've heard it. Then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T12-Q06.text: Pay attention to the times in this question, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T12-Q07.text: Each coin counts. Listen for every one, then work out how much there is and tap it.

MA-LIS-T12-Q08.text: Time question coming. Listen carefully, then work out the answer and tap it.

MA-LIS-T12-Q09.text: Coin counting time. Listen carefully to every coin, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T12-Q10.text: All aboard. Listen to the question about time, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T13-Q01.text: Two things are being compared. Listen, then tap the one the question asks for.

MA-LIS-T13-Q02.text: How do the two things compare? Listen closely, then tap the one that answers the question.

MA-LIS-T13-Q03.text: Listen to what's being compared, then tap the answer to the question.

MA-LIS-T13-Q04.text: Two things, one question. Listen carefully, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T13-Q05.text: You'll hear three things compared. Keep them in order in your head, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T13-Q06.text: Line up the three things in your mind as you listen. Then tap the answer to the question.

MA-LIS-T13-Q07.text: Three containers are compared here. Listen, sort them in your head, then tap the answer.

MA-LIS-T13-Q08.text: Think about what you heard, then tap your answer to the question.

MA-LIS-T13-Q09.text: Lots to keep track of here. Listen carefully, picture each comparison, then tap the answer that fits.

MA-LIS-T13-Q10.text: Every detail matters here. Listen closely, think it through, then tap the answer you believe is right.

MA-LIS-T14-Q01.text: Picture what's being shared as you listen. Then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T14-Q02.text: Fractions next. Listen carefully and imagine the parts, then tap the one you think is right.

MA-LIS-T14-Q03.text: Imagine the sharing happening as you listen. Then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T14-Q04.text: Think about the whole and its parts as you listen. Then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T14-Q05.text: Pieces to picture. Listen closely, then tap the fraction that answers the question.

MA-LIS-T14-Q06.text: Here's a question to picture in your head. Listen, work it out, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T14-Q07.text: A quick sketch in your head can help with this one. Listen carefully, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T14-Q08.text: Imagine a pizza as you listen. Then tap the answer to the question.

MA-LIS-T14-Q09.text: A pizza puzzle is coming. Listen carefully, picture it, then tap your answer.

MA-LIS-T14-Q10.text: Look at the pizza picture while you listen. Then tap the fraction that answers the question.

MA-LIS-T15-Q01.text: You'll hear three numbers and how to order them. Listen, then drag them into place.

MA-LIS-T15-Q02.text: Three numbers and an order to follow. Listen, then drag the numbers into that order.

MA-LIS-T15-Q03.text: Hold all the numbers in your head as you listen. Then drag them into the order you're asked for.

MA-LIS-T15-Q04.text: Three numbers are coming. Listen carefully, then put them in order by dragging.

MA-LIS-T15-Q05.text: There's an instruction at the end, after the three numbers. Listen, then drag them into order.

MA-LIS-T15-Q06.text: Some of these numbers sound alike, so listen carefully and think before you drag them into order.

MA-LIS-T15-Q07.text: Hear all three numbers before you move anything. Then drag them into the order asked for.

MA-LIS-T15-Q08.text: Number line-up time. Listen to three numbers, then drag them into the right order.

MA-LIS-T15-Q09.text: These numbers are near each other, so listen closely. Then drag them into the right order.

MA-LIS-T15-Q10.text: Three numbers want to line up. Listen to them and how they should stand, then drag them into place.
